body:
## Pull request overview

Adds a documented “parent continuation” contract so parent skills that invoke `lint-and-fix --no-push` can reliably continue their workflows after successful linting (and handle lint failures deterministically), while bumping affected plugin versions and regenerating the Codex mirror/marketplace metadata.

**Changes:**
- Define a “Parent Continuation Contract” in `lint-and-fix` and adjust `--no-push` behavior to be non-terminal when a continuation block is supplied.
- Update `pr` and `resolve-copilot-pr-feedback` to pass continuation blocks and react to `Lint status` outcomes.
- Bump plugin versions and update marketplace/catalog artifacts (including `dist/codex` mirror).
